responsibility: Companion VxWorks crtend object for GNAT exception-unwinding support. It contributes the terminating zero-length marker at the end of the EH_FRAME_SECTION_NAME section, choosing a target-appropriate 32-bit integer type and emitting a used, aligned __FRAME_END__ record. This file does not perform registration itself; its job is to close the .eh_frame data emitted by the matching vx_crtbegin objects so the unwinder sees a properly delimited frame-description section.
